system_name: Stregner Integrated Quest Story Framework (FTB Quest)
description: Five-chapter sequential quest framework with prerequisite chains, character dialogue hooks, sequencing rules, and AI-generation markers. Designed so any AI, given this schema plus task definitions, can generate a complete coherent story with dialogue, prerequisites, and event progression without ambiguity.
language_policy: English-only for source; AI may localize via this framework

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — Gathering
chapters.dialogue_hook: Seer uses Hive Sense to detect safe resources; Guardian proposes a defense plan using arrows and concealment before moving.
chapters.event_trigger: On food collection complete, Seer reveals a nearby village if one exists within bounded range; else team must travel a set distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Discovery
chapters.dialogue_hook: Seer discovers the village using her power; if no village exists, Scout is asked to search again with a specified target (biome / pyramid / structure).
chapters.event_trigger: On village discovery, Seer says: 'Follow me — I will lead you to the nearest settlement.'

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — Combat

tasks.label: Agree on arrow and concealment strategy

chapters.dialogue_hook: Team discusses tactics: arrows plus hiding; Guardian proposes defensive positions; Gifted offers Shield if protected-boundary checks pass.
chapters.event_trigger: After combat, Guardian writes a brief factual after-action review.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 — Armor Collection
chapters.dialogue_hook: Scout notes safe routes; Seer checks for nearby threats before collecting. Dialogue must reference previous combat plan.
chapters.event_trigger: On collection complete, team can proceed to final chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 — Conclusion

tasks.label: Full team dialogue and story resolution

chapters.dialogue_hook: Complete sequential story activation: user presses the command button; the framework unfolds all 5 chapters in order with full dialogue, prerequisites checked, and events sequenced.
chapters.event_trigger: Story completes; AI generates coherent narrative linking all chapters using this schema.

sequencing_rules.prerequisite_check: Before any chapter activates, all tasks in prerequisite_chapters must be completed.
sequencing_rules.dialogue_chain: Each chapter's dialogue references previous chapter outcomes.

ai_generation_guidance: Given this JSON framework plus the task list, generate: (1) full English dialogue for each chapter matching character roles; (2) prerequisite checks; (3) sequential event descriptions; (4) tactical discussions (e.g., arrow/concealment plans for zombies); (5) discovery events (village search, distance travel if no village); (6) a command that activates the complete 5-chapter story from start to finish in sequence. Every element must reference this schema so the AI produces a coherent, precise, detailed story without ambiguity.
